name: Supertonic 3 voice
why: Reads videos aloud on your Mac, offline and free.

darwin.check: test -x "$HOME/.careeros/venv/bin/python" && "$HOME/.careeros/venv/bin/python" -c 'import sys, importlib.metadata as m; sys.exit(m.version("supertonic") != "1.3.1")'
install: py="$(for p in python3 python3.14 python3.13 python3.12 python3.11; do b="$(command -v $p)" || continue; [ "$b" = /usr/bin/python3 ] && continue; "$b" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if (3, 11) <= sys.version_info[:2] <= (3, 14) else 1)' && echo "$b" && break; done)" && test -n "$py" && "$py" -m venv "$HOME/.careeros/venv"
